headline: Iraq Seeks Federal Control Over Kurdistan Oil Fields After Smuggling Probe
summary: Iraq's Oil Ministry announced plans to place oilfields in the Kurdistan region under federal North Oil Company control following an investigation into crude oil smuggling in the northern fields.
why: Iraq is the second-largest crude producer in OPEC, and internal disputes over oil rights between Baghdad and Kurdistan frequently disrupt regional oil output.

impacts.name: Iraqi Oil Sector
impacts.why: Transferring control of Kurdistan fields to federal management alters operational oversight and crude distribution.
